text:
maria: Quick proposal — surface "observed routing" signals in the Console and add an opt-in SDK field so we can show whether a request used an explicit route or was inferred by the routing layer. would help debugging cost spikes :eyes:
kevin: curious — by "observed" you mean the route the runtime actually chose, not the client hint, right?
tess: yes, we get a lot of tickets where console shows Route A but app devs swore they used Route B. showing "inferred_vs_explicit" could cut down on these.
roman: from python sdk side — adding a header is trivial, but we should avoid accidentally changing routing behavior. need opt-in + clear fallback.
sarah: TS SDK same. suggestion: expose `client.route_observed` boolean and `client.route_confidence` float in telemetry events rather than changing routing headers by default.
maria: good call. idea: runtime emits `route.observed` events and console links those to request traces. SDKs can attach `X-RW-Observed-OptIn: true` when devs want route inference telemetry included. default off.
roman: sample curl we could document:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-RW-Observed-OptIn: true" 
     -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
kevin: how do we avoid double-counting in metrics? if console shows observed route for small sample, customers might assume routing split is different. need sampling and clear UI language about coverage.
tess: propose sample rate 0.5% by default, configurable per-tenant in Console -> Advanced Routing -> Observed Telemetry. show sample size and confidence intervals on the tile.
sarah: telemetry payload size concern — `route.observed` adds a few fields. suggest we compress: include `route_id` (short) + `inferred:true|false` + `confidence:0-1`. everything else already in trace.
maria: privacy/legal check: are we leaking anything sensitive by surfacing inferred routing? ops, any concerns?
ops: legal side looks ok but we should record data retention defaults (30d) and provide a toggle to disable for orgs. also add audit log entry when an admin enables observed telemetry.
roman: backwards compat: older SDKs won't send the opt-in header but runtime will still emit `route.observed` events at the infrastructure level. the value we link in Console will be "observed by runtime" vs "client-opted". we should surface both.
kevin: rollout plan idea: 1) lab-only event capture for 2 weeks; 2) add SDK opt-in flag and doc for dev preview; 3) 1% public sampling with banner in Console; 4) full customer opt-in toggle. timelines?
tess: can we ship the console UI for lab-only first? a debug-only tile that only internal eng sees. avoids confusing customers.
maria: yep. internal -> preview -> public. internal tile will show raw `route.observed` stream and a small tool to correlate with traces.
sarah: SDK ergonomics: expose `client.config({ observedRouting: { enabled: boolean, sampleRate: 0.01 }})`. default disabled. update CHANGELOGs and release notes with clear migration doc.
roman: also add a lint rule in python-sdk that warns when `observedRouting.enabled` is true in prod env variables (we don't want accidental large-scale enabling).
kevin: telemetry sampling: server-side sampling vs client-side sampling? server-side gives consistent numerator for billing and capacity signals. client-side is cheaper to implement across languages. tradeoffs?
ops: prefer server-side sampling for accuracy; client-side opt-in for devs to reduce spam during early preview. server-side can still respect tenant opt-out.
maria: last piece — dashboards: show `observed_route` breakdown, sample size, and a confidence band; also mark datapoints that come from client-opted vs runtime-only. Tess will mock the UI.
tess: I'll put a sketch in #design later today.
kevin: action items: @roman and @sarah add opt-in config to SDKs (PRs), @tess mock Console tile, @ops add retention/opt-out defaults, @maria draft rollout announcement and docs.
devbot: canary deployment started for routing-observed-ingest on infra-canary-3 (build 2026.3.14-rc) :partyparrot:
maria: thanks — let's sync tomorrow after sketches.
kevin: +1
